pages.title: Brown Dwarf Core
pages.text: The dense heart of a failed star: too light to fuse hydrogen, heavy enough once to burn its deuterium. It still glows with the heat of its own contraction.

Made in $(item)Tectonic Press$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Brown Dwarf Remnant$(), in veins through the rock.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Accretion Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Accretion Disk Plasma, Interstellar Dust, Quasar Jet Filament, Rare Earth Oxide.
